detector: cdpe_sens.author_detector (author's published detector) [input fields land-masked; detector unchanged]
secondary_metric: n_events (contiguous-run count from cdpe_sens.events.event_table; labelled, never conflated with n_cdpe_months)
detector_callable: cdpe_sens.author_detector.make_author_detector (wrapped: land mask applied to input field)

land_mask.application: Water cells set to NaN in every computed index field before detection; cdpe_sens.author_detector itself unmodified. Reproduces Arm A semantics (SPEIbase ocean cells are fill/NaN).
land_mask.source_product: SPEIbase v2.10 spei01.nc (land-only product; ocean cells are fill in every month)
land_mask.speibase_release: v2.10 (CRU TS 4.08 based, SPEI R package 1.8.1, Jan 1901 - Dec 2023), Digital.CSIC record 10261/364137, DOI 10.20350/digitalCSIC/16497. NOTE: v2.11 (CRU TS 4.09, through Dec 2024) is listed at https://spei.csic.es/database.html but its file endpoints could not be reached from this network on 2026-10-04; v2.10 was obtained instead and the substitution is disclosed in data/DATA_MANIFEST.md. The 1980-2024 baseline check therefore runs on 1980-2023 with this release.
land_mask.land_rule: SPEIbase cell is land iff finite in >= 1 month of the window (audit AUDIT_FINDINGS.md Item 2)
land_mask.transfer_to_arm_b_grid: nearest SPEIbase cell per Arm B cell (grids offset 0.25 deg; numpy argmin first-occurrence ties, as in the audit)
land_mask.scope_note: Mask is global land inside the bounding box (Canadian/Mexican land cells are land), matching Arm A; it is not a US-only mask.
